#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the self-signed development TLS certificate."""

from pathlib import Path

from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes

CERT_PATH = Path("/app/ssl/server.crt")


def main() -> None:
    if not CERT_PATH.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Certificate not found: {CERT_PATH}")

    cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(CERT_PATH.read_bytes())

    cn_attrs = cert.subject.get_attributes_for_oid(x509.NameOID.COMMON_NAME)
    if not cn_attrs:
        raise ValueError("Certificate has no Common Name (CN)")
    common_name = cn_attrs[0].value

    expiration = cert.not_valid_after_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    fingerprint = cert.fingerprint(hashes.SHA256()).hex(":").upper()

    print(f"Certificate loaded: {CERT_PATH}")
    print(f"Common Name: {common_name}")
    print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration}")
    print(f"SHA-256 Fingerprint: {fingerprint}")
    print("Certificate verification successful")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify the self-signed development TLS certificate."""

from pathlib import Path

from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes

    cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(CERT_PATH.read_bytes())

    print(f"Common Name: {common_name}")
    print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration}")
    print(f"SHA-256 Fingerprint: {fingerprint}")
    print("Certificate verification successful")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the self-signed development TLS certificate."""

from pathlib import Path

from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes

CERT_PATH = Path("/app/ssl/server.crt")


def main() -> None:
    if not CERT_PATH.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Certificate not found: {CERT_PATH}")

    cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(CERT_PATH.read_bytes())

    cn_attrs = cert.subject.get_attributes_for_oid(x509.NameOID.COMMON_NAME)
    if not cn_attrs:
        raise ValueError("Certificate has no Common Name (CN)")
    common_name = cn_attrs[0].value

    expiration = cert.not_valid_after_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    fingerprint = cert.fingerprint(hashes.SHA256()).hex(":").upper()

    print(f"Certificate loaded: {CERT_PATH}")
    print(f"Common Name: {common_name}")
    print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration}")
    print(f"SHA-256 Fingerprint: {fingerprint}")
    print("Certificate verification successful")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
